While many have highlighted the killings of farmers in South Africa, this violence is emblematic of much broader problems, he says.

South Africa’s murder rate is among the highest in the world—more than seven times higher than the global average. And race-based policies and distribution of wealth are having a serious deleterious effect, Roets says. 

South Africa is also facing a major water crisis, with nearly half of the water supply systems found to be contaminated and two-thirds of wastewater treatment works close to breaking down. 

In this episode, Roets breaks down why he believes South Africa’s current political system is fundamentally not sustainable.
